summary: Packaged the backfill-agent-journal skill as a workspace extension `@gizmo/memory-extension` so Gizmo's registry discovers it through `gizmo.extensions.json` instead of a loose user-level skill. Wrote the standalone backfill script, SKILL.md, the extension's package.json/tsconfig, a minimal `GizmoServerExtension` entry whose entry-point depth is three levels (so `packageRoot` resolves correctly), and registered the extension in `gizmo.extensions.json` followed by `pnpm install`.
decisions: Ship the skill through Gizmo's extension registry (`@gizmo/memory-extension` listed in `gizmo.extensions.json`) rather than as a loose user-level skill.

Extension's server entry lives at `src/server/index.ts` (three levels under the entry file) so Gizmo's `packageRoot` walk lands on the package directory and its skills are found; a shallower path would resolve one level too high.
Backfill script kept as a zero-dependency standalone `.mjs` so it runs in any repo regardless of stack; cross-checked against the TypeScript implementation (delta attributed to this session growing).
